item.text: {"candidates":[{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Window counting followed by DISTINCT preserves each hour group, including NULL, and returns BIGINT counts.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips"},{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Two-stage aggregation counts pickup-location subgroups and combines them per hour, casting the sum back to BIGINT.","sql":"SELECT hour, CAST(SUM(partial_trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS partial_trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1, 2) AS partials GROUP BY hour"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Conditional aggregation retains the original day predicate and removes routes with no qualifying rows.","sql":"SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Window counting over qualifying rows followed by DISTINCT preserves route groups, NULL keys, and duplicate counts.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7"}]}
